Factual record & care

Material provenance monograph

Yoga & Practice · OPAR Construction Sample

Yoga & Practice focuses on durable movement props—floor mats, solid cork blocks, bolsters, and breath cushions—chosen for tactile grip and quiet colour without bright gym branding.

Presenting a rolled textile mat alongside a chamfered natural cork block shows how multi-part practice kits read in the gallery, cart thumbnails, and order confirmations.

Confirmed thickness measurements, rubber/hemp material breakdown, and parcel courier weight calculations will populate once manufacturer specs clear review.

Care & handling

Wipe cork with a slightly damp cloth and air-dry completely before stacking. Unroll mat flat periodically out of strong sunlight.

What OPAR Will Not Claim

Unverified treatment, brightening, cure, or unsubstantiated certification copy is stripped from this folio.

Questions about this piece

Can mats and blocks be ordered together as sets?

The sample variant selector illustrates how single-block and paired sets work inside one unified SKU flow.

Are weight and dimensions final?

No. Full thickness, length, and parcel shipping weights are confirmed once the supplier spec sheet clears review.

Does OPAR claim this set treats back pain or stress?

No. Practice equipment is offered purely for physical floor support and comfort without medical promises.
